about: Every picture in this book: who made it and when, the work it was first published in, who owns it and on what grounds it may be used, where this copy came from, and each change made to it since. An item taken from elsewhere keeps the original's hash in source.sha256 and lists every crop, resize or colour change in adjustments; sha256 is the file as it is in this book.

fields.creator: name, role (artist, engraver, photographer…), lived (years)
fields.original: the work it was first published in: work, publisher, place, year, page or plate; null if made for this book
fields.rights: status (public-domain, licensed, dedicated, permission), licence, holder, basis (why it may be used), checked (date)
fields.source: where this copy came from: url, retrieved (date), sha256 of the file as downloaded; null if made for this book
fields.adjustments: each change, oldest first: date, by, what
